load_dust3r_model: load a pretrained DUSt3R model from a checkpoint file path onto a specified device
create_asymmetric_croco_stereo: create an AsymmetricCroCo3DStereo model with configurable output mode, head type, and depth prediction settings
load_pretrained_asymmetric_croco: load a pretrained AsymmetricCroCo3DStereo model from a HuggingFace Hub repo or local checkpoint file
forward_stereo_inference: run forward inference on a pair of image views to predict 3D points in view1's frame
create_flash_dust3r: create a FlashDUSt3R model for multi-view 3D reconstruction with configurable decoder and attention settings
